timed_text.text: It's called box breathing. Four sides. Four seconds each.
When you're in a high-pressure moment, your body runs hot.
Box breathing is a reset switch.
When you control the breath, you directly activate the part of your nervous system that says calm down.
On your screen you're going to see a circle. Follow it.
If your mind drifts — bring it back. That is not failure. That is the drill.

visual_cues: Follow the circle. In through your nose.
Stay with the rhythm. Don't rush.
Nice and steady. Four seconds each.
Mind drifted? Good. Bring it back.
You're building a skill. Stay present.
Last two reps. Stay locked in.

timed_text.text: Do that before your next practice. Before your next competition.

blocks.prompt: Where did your mind go during the breathing? What thought kept pulling you away from the breath?
